faqs.q: Can Myntmore connect Ahmedabad textile mills directly with US and European fashion brands?
faqs.a: Yes. We map Head of Fabric Sourcing, Product Development, and VP Supply Chain contacts directly inside mid-market and enterprise brands in the US, UK, EU, and Australia.

faqs.q: How do you avoid wasting our merchandising team's time with tiny startup orders below our MOQ?
faqs.a: We filter target brands by revenue tier, store count, and product category before sending outreach, and confirm MOQ alignment before booking calls or shipping swatch cards.

faqs.q: Can you highlight our OEKO-TEX, GOTS, GRS, or vertical mill advantages?
faqs.a: Yes. Sustainability certifications, in-house dyeing/finishing, and faster sample turnaround are some of the highest-converting hooks with Western textile buyers.

faqs.q: Can you pre-book buyer meetings before Heimtextil, Texworld, or Bharat Tex?
faqs.a: Yes. Running a focused 6-week pre-show outbound sprint ensures your leadership arrives at international exhibitions with confirmed buyer meetings already on the calendar.

faqs.q: How quickly do catalogue and sampling replies begin?
faqs.a: Setup, domain warming, and buyer list verification take 2 weeks. Initial sourcing replies and swatch requests typically start in weeks 3 to 5.
